verified_facts.text: The resort is less than two hours from Bangkok.
verified_facts.excerpt: Less than two hours from Bangkok, InterContinental Pattaya Resort is a tropical beach oasis

verified_facts.text: The resort looks out over the Gulf of Thailand and Koh Larn (Coral Island).
verified_facts.excerpt: offers unsurpassed views of the Gulf of Thailand, Koh Larn (Coral Island), and beyond

verified_facts.text: The resort is at 437 Phra Tamnak Road in Pattaya.
verified_facts.excerpt: 437 Phra Tamnak Road Chonburi Pattaya

verified_facts.text: The location gives easy access to Pattaya Floating Market and Walking Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s convenient location offers easy access to Pattaya’s famous attractions, including Pattaya Floating Market and Walking Street.

verified_facts.text: The resort has three lagoon-style pools, Spirituality Lagoon, Splash Lagoon and Serenity Pool, surrounded by lush greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our three stunning lagoon-style pools, surrounded by lush greenery, are perfect for swimming and sunbathing

verified_facts.text: The shallow Splash Lagoon is suited to younger guests and kids.
verified_facts.excerpt: The shallow Splash Lagoon is ideal for our younger guests and kids.

verified_facts.text: Amburaya Spa uses organic botanicals for facial and body treatments and has six private suites for couples and individuals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring organic botanicals for facial and body treatments, Amburaya Spa has six private suites perfect for both couples and individuals.

verified_facts.text: The spa's signature Amburaya Embrace is a full-body massage combining five massage therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: including the Amburaya Embrace--a full-body massage that features the combination of five massage therapies

verified_facts.text: Classic rooms come in Garden View, Ocean View and Pool Terrace versions, decorated with contemporary Asian elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: classic category comprises of Garden View, Ocean View and Pool Terrace Rooms, decorated with contemporary Asian elements

verified_facts.text: All rooms have a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms are outfitted with unlimited internet access and a private balcony with stunning views.

verified_facts.text: Pool villas, with one or two bedrooms, may include an outdoor private pool, an outdoor pavilion, an oceanfront sunset view, beach access and lounge access.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Outdoor Private Pool
- Outdoor Pavilion
- Oceanfront, Sunset View

verified_facts.text: Infiniti Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant with sunset views over the Gulf of Thailand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Infiniti Restaurant offers an unforgettable Italian grilled dining experience, set against stunning sunset views over the Gulf of Thailand.

verified_facts.text: Elements Restaurant serves Thai and international cuisine, with a BBQ seafood buffet every Saturday, indoors or on an alfresco terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in the renowned Marvelous BBQ Seafood Buffet every Saturday, offering the freshest seafood and an array of gourmet dishes.

verified_facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge serves breakfast, afternoon tea, and complimentary evening drinks and canapes with sunset views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary drinks and canapés in the Club Lounge in the evening, with the best sunset views in Pattaya.

verified_facts.text: Wedding specialists arrange beach weddings with ocean-view or indoor settings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bring your dream beach wedding to life. Our attentive wedding specialists will curate and personalise every detail for your big day.
